messages:
sam-senior: Heads up  I'm planning a 6-week unpaid sabbatical (personal project) from 2026-12-20 -> 2027-01-31 but it overlaps our year-end paid shutdown (2026-12-24 -> 2026-12-31). Can we handle PTO/sick carryover and blackout constraints? Need clarity on pay and accruals.
linda-peopleops: Congrats on the sabbatical! A few rules: 1) unpaid leaves don't accrue PTO during the leave. 2) if you're on payroll during the paid company shutdown week you get those days as company holiday pay — but since your leave starts 12/20 we need to confirm payroll status on 12/24.
oliver-manager: Manager note: operationally we need to ensure coverage for product freeze week. If Sam is unpaid starting 12/20, we should finalize on-call swaps. Sam, can you shift start to 1/1 to keep the shutdown pay?
sam-senior: I'd prefer to keep the 12/20 start to align with my travel. If I lose shutdown pay, what's the recourse? Can I convert accrued PTO to cover some of the unpaid period so I stay on payroll?
linda-peopleops: Options: A) Keep unpaid leave starting 12/20: you won't be on payroll for the shutdown and won't receive paid shutdown days. B) Use accrued PTO to cover 12/24-12/31 so payroll sees you as active and paid. C) One-time exception request: People Ops can evaluate keeping you on payroll for shutdown if you remain on benefits (requires exec approval).
ben-payroll: Practical notes: to have shutdown counted as paid we must see PTO entries or active payroll status on 2026-12-24. If option B: please log PTO in Workday for 2026-12-24..12-31 and we will process as usual. If option C: we need a signed exception form by 2026-12-01 to guarantee payroll processing.
sam-senior: I have 8 accrued PTO days and 4 sick days. If I book PTO for 12/24-12/31 that uses 6 PTO days (working days) right? Do sick days apply?
linda-peopleops: Correct, 12/24-12/31 is 6 working days for you. Sick days can't be used proactively for planned sabbatical. You can convert up to 2 sick days to PTO only in specific medical circumstances (not applicable here). Suggest: book 6 PTO days to cover shutdown. That leaves you with 2 PTO days leftover before unpaid leave starts.
oliver-manager: For team planning, please post your on-call swap by EOD Friday if you're taking the 12/20 start.
sam-senior: Ok I'll book PTO 12/24-12/31 and submit exception request just in case. If exec sign-off is needed, who signs it?
linda-peopleops: Exec approval route: People Ops prepares the exception memo -> manager signs -> Head of Eng final sign-off. Timeline ~1-2 weeks. Submit here: https://hr.redwood/leave-exception.
hr-bot: Reminder: PTO entries must be in Workday before payroll cutoff (2026-12-15) to avoid manual payroll adjustments.
ben-payroll: If PTO is submitted after cutoff we can run: 
```n/payroll_adjust --emp=ESAM001 --retro --ppto=6 --ef=2026-12-24
```
but it requires HR audit doc attached.
sam-senior: Filed the PTO days and exception form. Thanks all, I'll post on-call swap in #eng-oncall.
